posts.title: Air Over Bone
posts.description: This offering of quiet poetry seeks to unite through the collective experience of heartbreak, redemption, and living in a modern tapestry that seems to be unraveling one sunset thread at a time. Air Over Bone was my first collection of poetry, self published in 2018 as a print book that I have since decided to give it away for free as a PDF. posts.title: The Leaving Women
posts.description: In The Leaving Women, we have two women who meet on a train, Shelley and Leigha. Very different women who are both leaving something behind. They take turns telling their stories to each other as the train carries them further from their pasts.
